quarterly_data.quarter: Keel Infrastructure press release: Keel Infrastructure Supports Governor Shapiro's GRID (08-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Keel said permitting at its Panther Creek and Sharon (Pennsylvania) data center sites continues to proceed on schedule and is unaffected by Executive Order 2026-05, signed August 18 by Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro to set the GRID standards for data center development, which Keel endorsed. Keel: its Pennsylvania development model is built around bringing its own power, and it pays the interconnection, transmission, distribution and network upgrade costs attributable to its own load; its data centers are designed to use closed-loop cooling.
